sentences.en: The many irregularities in your language don't really alleviate boredom.
sentences.zh: 你语言中的诸多不规则之处并不能减轻我的无聊感。

sentences.en: He is the last man to commit an irregularity.
sentences.zh: 他绝不会犯下任何不规则的错误。

sentences.en: I think your language is just boring. Irregularities don't interest me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你的语言只是很枯燥。我不喜欢那些不规则的部分。

senses.zh: 不规则，无规律,非正则，非正式,不整齐,不规则的事物
